name: NH Collection Madrid Palacio de Tepa
description: Designed by Juan de Villanueva, NH Collection Madrid Palacio de Tepa is set in the building that served as a palace for Count Tepa. Today, the hotel provides the perfect location to access all of Madrid's iconic sites. Prado, Reina Sofía and Thyssen museums are close by, as are the Royal Palace, Plaza Mayor and Puerta del Sol. For the gourmands, walk to some of Madrid's most famous restaurants, such as Botín and Casa Lucio. The rooms at NH Collection Madrid Palacio de Tepa are spacious and let in a lot of natural light. Many enjoy fantastic views of historic Madrid. Connecting rooms are available and all rooms are equipped with free Wi-Fi. A gym and spa are available on-site. The hotel's Guest Relations team will be delighted to assist you in purchasing tickets or making reservations during your stay. In the morning, delight in a fresh breakfast. A 7-minute walk away from the hotel, you will find Paco Roncero Restaurante, a gourmet restaurant awarded two Michelin stars.
